messages:
mira: Heads up — audit-event-validator is failing in CI after the RBAC change. Seeing errors for KMS rotation events and the new actor_role field. Failing on staging build 342. stack trace below.

sec-ci-bot: buildkite | pipeline #342 failed: audit-validator-tests (unit) 3/12 failed. https://ci.redwood.example/pipelines/342 

jon: which tests are failing? can you paste the failing assertion and the event payload?

mira: sure — pasted below (sanitized):
```
FAIL: tests/test_kms_events.py::test_kms_rotate_event_schema
AssertionError: Missing required property: 'actor_role'
Event sample:
{
  "event_type": "kms.key.rotate",
  "timestamp": "2025-09-14T18:22:31Z",
  "actor": { "id": "svc-12345", "principal_id": "user:alice" },
  "resource": { "key_id": "projects/p-1/keys/k-9" },
  "metadata": { "rotation_reason": "scheduled" }
}
```

eli: looks like our golden fixture for kms_rotate doesn't include actor_role and the schema change made it required. did we land the RBAC change in the schema without updating fixtures? cc @sam

sam: I landed a schema PR that bumped actor_role from optional -> required (PR #987). I thought we had updated fixtures but maybe missed some KMS ones.

eli: that explains it. validator treats missing principal_id/role as fatal for rotations because we're enforcing identity provenance for key ops. KMS rotation events from older infra only had actor.id and principal_id sometimes missing.

jon: short-term options: 1) update golden fixtures to include actor_role where appropriate, 2) relax the schema to accept legacy events (accept null/missing), or 3) add a normalization layer in the validator that fills actor_role from other fields when present.

ops-ryan: also flag — staging KMS rotation uses ephemeral subjects, so subject format differs from prod. normalization will help across environments.

mira: proposed plan:
- update golden fixtures for kms.rotate (I'm on it)
- add a CI regression that fails if fixture-schema drift occurs (fixture <-> schema parity check)
- add a quick validation shim to accept missing actor_role for legacy rotations until we can roll the migration everywhere
- follow-up RFC to make actor_role required and a migration window documented

sec-ci-bot: buildkite | re-run triggered by mira: pipeline #342 requeued.

sam: I'll open a rollback PR to mark actor_role as optional while we fix fixtures. then we can push a stricter PR with migration notes.

jon: thanks. mira, when you push fixture updates can you paste the diff here and tag me? I want to add a unit test that verifies fixture coverage for RBAC fields and KMS event variants.

mira: :thumbsup: will do. I'll update fixtures in a branch and open a small PR with the normalization shim. If this touches customer-visible audit events we'll run through a quick postmortem and notify CS.

sam: agree — we should avoid client-facing schema churn. RFC incoming.

eli: also adding a short note for the oncall runbook: if audit-validator starts failing lots of rotations, temporarily disable the strict gate and notify sec + infra.

mira: noted. thanks everyone, I'll start on the fixture patch now and follow up with PRs and CI links.
